messages:
priya: Heads-up: I'm putting together pilot acceptance heuristics for the Optimize Toolkit but want to call out privacy/SLA constraints up-front. Quick alignment?

leo: what's the highest risk item here?

priya: Two quick ones: 1) eval-triggered alerts must not leak PII in alerts/examples, and 2) quant profiling must respect customer data residency (some pilots will run in VPC).

tom: agreed. For (1) we should default to redacted examples and only include full context if customer explicitly permits.

emily: For VPC profiling, we need an installer variant + KMS hooks. That's infra work but doable for pilot customers (AcmeHealth).

rachel: Also consider SLA: pilots expect 99.9 uptime on advisor UI + alerts within X minutes. We should be explicit about acceptable windows.

priya: Draft acceptance criteria (for review):
```
AC-001: Alerts redact candidate PII (emails, SSNs, phone numbers) by default; redaction toggled per-customer opt-in.
AC-002: Eval-alerts include a "sample diff" with only token-level snippets (<= 80 chars) and a link to full context in customer-owned VPC.
AC-003: Profiling runs for quant recommendations respect residency: either run in Redwood-hosted infra (no PII) or in-customer VPC runner.
AC-004: Pilot SLA: alerts delivered to console + webhook within 20 minutes of detection 95% of the time.
AC-005: Advisor UI must show impact estimate (latency, cost) and a small sample side-by-side for top-2 configs.
```

leo: For AC-003, suggest we cap profiling to 500 samples/model/run and expose a cost-estimate before start.

priya: noted, will add cap.

emily: UX note: show a clear "data residency" badge and a small lock icon on any sample that required VPC access.

rachel: Ops/runbook: include an on-call triage flow for false positives and a way for customers to mark an alert as "known issue" to suppress repeats.

priya: Good call. Also thinking about econ threshold gating: require either >=10% unit-cost reduction or >=50ms p95 latency drop across 2 pilot customers to enable auto-apply flows in phase 2. Otherwise recommend advisory-only.

tom: How do we test alert precision? Need an eval harness with labeled regressions or synthetic prompts.

leo: We can seed failing prompt suites from customers + synthetic mutation set. Target precision > 0.8 on combined set.

priya: Action items: 
- @emily: mockups for redacted sample diff + residency badge by Thu.
- @leo: prototype 500-sample profiler with cost calc and residency toggles by Mon.
- @tom: build small labeled harness (cust + synthetic) for alert precision testing by Wed.
- @rachel: draft SLA wording + runbook stub.

ops-bot: reminder set for 1766350000: "Pilot acceptance artifacts due" :alarm_clock:

priya: Thanks. I'll fold into the initiative backing doc and circulate for legal/privacy review before next week.
